conf.description: syslog-relay daemon-operational / syslog-raw: hand-built BSD-envelope + free-text message-form parser for rsyslogd/syslog-ng's own operational log (no integration/pack covers this); derives event.action from a bounded, pinned set of 8 documented message forms per recommendations.direct.cribl, computed before the batched rename.

conf.comment: syslog-relay / daemon-operational / syslog-raw. Splits the BSD envelope (PRI/HOSTNAME/APP-NAME/MSG), then independently regex-matches MSG against the bounded pinned message-form set the work order documents for rsyslogd (start via origin SD block, HUPed, action suspended/resumed+module, imuxsock ratelimit-drop) and syslog-ng (starting-up version, reload, connection-broken, queue-full-drop). Message wording is not a stable API across releases per the work order - re-test on every daemon point release. Direct route, no guard hop.

functions.description: record dataset, format, and the pinned-message-form approach
split the BSD syslog envelope (PRI, header timestamp, HOSTNAME, APP-NAME[+pid]) from the daemon's own message body
rsyslog's RFC5424 structured-data origin block (software/swVersion/x-pid), present on lifecycle records; trailing text discriminates start vs. exiting
extract the numeric, version-independent rsyslog error id from the trailing rsyslog.com/e/NNNN hint on error messages
rsyslog action suspended|resumed(+module) - one word differs the direction, so verb and module are captured together

syslog-ng configuration-reload notice - the change-control trail for the collection tier itself

syslog-ng destination queue-full drop - configured ceiling the stats-feed dropped counter is measured against
syslog-ng driver identifier, when present on a queue/connection record - join key back to the stats dataset's object_id
